
==== Ways You Can Help ====

* Work on [http://www.lojban.org/jbovlaste/needed/ efinitions Or Votes Needed].  This link is now for any language, natlang or valsi.
* If you speak languages other than English, please go work on the list of [[jbovlaste import: Front Pages Needed lang en]]. When one is at a wiki page, the equivalent page for other languages can be found in the bottom right hand corner.

* Work on [[jbovlaste import: adding gismu gloss words lang en]]
* Find [[jbovlaste import: Things that should be in the printed dictionary hings that should be in the printed dictionary lang en]]

* Work on the list of [[jbovlaste import: lujvo mentioned in the word lists lang en]].
* Work on the list of [[jbovlaste import: noralujv entries with no definitions lang en]], especially if you're an oldbie.

==== Helpful tools ====

* Please [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-index.php?page=Corpora earch] for occurences of words before you define them.
* As natlang keywords, we want any and all words for which the Lojban word in question is a reasonable translation. Use services such as [http://www.dict.org/ ict] or [http://wordnet.princeton.edu/cgi-bin/webwn ordNet] (English only) to find synonyms.

* For finding good keywords for single-word-untranslatable terms, try OneLook's [http://onelook.com/reverse-dictionary.shtml everse dictionary].
* For some old and obscure lujvo, it might be helpful to look up the corresponding Loglan complex in John W. Kennedy's [http://john.w.kennedy.googlepages.com/javaloglansoftware oglan Online Dictionary].

* For help on wiki formatting, see [http://www.lojban.org/jbovlaste/help/wikitext.html he wiki text help file].
